Caption / description / post text:
Baked French Onion Dip with Gruyère and Pancetta 🧅🍂 Episode 2 of my Thanksgiving Sides Series! Deeply caramelized onions, nutty Gruyère, crispy pancetta, and a golden, bubbling cheese top.  Basically French onion soup in dip form, and exactly what I want to snack on while Thanksgiving dinner’s cooking. The full recipe is linked in my bio! It’s free :) #dips #thanksgiving #thanksgivingsides #caramelizedonions #sides  

Transcript of the video's audio (machine-made):
Welcome to Thanksgiving sides episode two. Today we're turning French onion soup into a hot and cheesy dip with gruyere and pancetta. Here's your bite. Here's my bite. That will be gone in seconds and here's how to make it. In a large pot, doesn't have to be a pumpkin, but helps if it is. Add your pancetta, then turn the heat on and let it render until it's golden and crispy. Remove the pancetta, then add in the onions with a pinch of salt and a splash of water, then cover to help them get started and uncover and cook them down super slowly until deeply golden and jammed. Once they're done, season with your grated garlic and fresh thyme, then deglaze with your sherry, let that cook off and then set them aside. Now for the base, combine your softened cream cheese, mayo and sour cream along with your freshly grated gruyere and mozzarella, those caramelized onions, a little bit of pancetta and a tiny splash of basil. Spread it into a baking dish, top with more cheese, bake until bubbly and enjoy.
